note: The committed shape of the standard's own self-check battery (src/selfcheck.mjs, run by `memstruct check`). The status emitter (web/scripts/build-status.mjs) runs the live battery and reconciles it against this list: a check that passes reads PASSED, a check whose name is missing from the live run reads MISSING (a silently-deleted check is a smaller green, refused), and any live check not listed here reads UNLISTED (an unaccounted-for check is refused too). Edit this file in the same commit that adds or removes a check.
